entries.title: Psalms 67:1
segments: <<For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. A Psalm, a song.>> God be merciful unto us, and bless us, [And] cause his face to shine upon us; Selah

entries.title: Psalms 67:2
segments: That thy way may be known upon earth, Thy salvation among all nations.

entries.title: Psalms 67:3
segments: Let the peoples praise thee, O God; Let all the peoples  praise thee.

entries.title: Psalms 67:4
segments: Oh let the nations be glad and sing for joy; For thou wilt judge the peoples with equity, And govern the nations upon earth. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 67:5
segments: Let the peoples praise thee, O God; Let all the peoples praise thee.

entries.title: Psalms 67:6
segments: The earth hath yielded its increase: God, even our own God, will bless us.

entries.title: Psalms 67:7
segments: God will bless us; And all the ends of the earth shall fear him.
